project.name: KHKD - Anglerfish Ca Cau Cau Bien Sau
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — anglerfish con duc tan vao than con cai thanh tui tinh
project.story: Deep-sea anglerfish have the most extreme sexual dimorphism in nature. The female is large with the iconic bioluminescent lure dangling above her head. The male is tiny, parasitic. When he finds a female in the deep dark ocean, he bites her body and fuses to her flesh permanently. His blood vessels merge with hers, his organs dissolve one by one — eyes, gills, intestines — until he becomes nothing but a permanent testicle attached to her, feeding off her blood, providing sperm on demand. A large female can carry up to 6 fused males on her body.
